title: Echocardiography in Awake Mice
author: E. Dale Abel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7s7hnhn

steps.title: Prepare anesthesia (if needed)
steps.instruction: If anesthesia is required, use inhaled isoflurane at 1% delivered via a nose cone and titrate the flow to keep heart rate >400 bpm; if isoflurane is unavailable, use avertin (tribromoethanol) at 0.2 ml per 10 g body weight or chloral hydrate at 0.5 mg per g body weight.

steps.title: Remove chest hair
steps.instruction: Apply a topical depilatory agent to the mouse chest to remove hair before imaging.

steps.title: Attach ECG leads and position mouse
steps.instruction: Attach limb leads for electrocardiogram gating, then place the mouse in the left lateral decubitus position.

steps.title: Acquire 2‑D and M‑mode images
steps.instruction: Using a 13‑MHz linear probe (Vivid FiVe; GE Medical Systems), record two‑dimensional images in parasternal long‑axis and short‑axis projections and obtain guided M‑mode recordings at the mid‑ventricular level in both views.

steps.title: Measure LV dimensions
steps.instruction: From the M‑mode recordings, measure left ventricular cavity size and wall thickness (interventricular septum and posterior wall) on at least three consecutive beats for each projection and average the values; also record internal dimensions at diastole (LVIDd) and systole (LVIDs).

steps.title: Calculate functional parameters
steps.instruction: Compute LV fractional shortening = (LVIDd – LVIDs) / LVIDd, relative wall thickness = (IVS + PW) / LVIDd, and LV mass = 1.05 × (IVS + LVIDd + PW)³ – LVIDd³ using the averaged measurements.
